messages:
maria: 👀 noticing weird rows in Console run list — workspace A showing a couple of runs that belong to workspace B. Screenshot: https://internal.s3/redwood/console-ghost-rows.png

devon: ugh. repro for you? I only see it when I filter by `status:failed` and `owner:me` in the UI.

maria: repro steps in case it helps: open /console/runs, set workspace dropdown to 'AcmeCorp (workspace-a)', set filter `status:failed`, click first page. Two rows at bottom have workspace tag 'workspace-b' and the run IDs link to workspace-b's run page.

sachin: can you paste the run IDs? curious if it's UI-only or backend mis-scoping.

maria: run IDs: `r_20260314_9a2f`, `r_20260314_b7c1`. I pasted logs from network tab:
```
GET /api/v1/runs?workspace=workspace-a&status=failed&page=1 HTTP/1.1
200 OK
[ {"id":"r_20260314_9a2f","workspace":"workspace-b",...}, {"id":"r_20260314_7d33","workspace":"workspace-a",...} ]
```

olivia: wow the API returned a workspace-b object back when workspace param was workspace-a? that's probably a query scoping bug in the run list service.

devon: quick thought — last week I refactored the search middleware to allow combined filters and I added an optimization that conditionally omits `workspace_id` when `owner=me` (because owner constraint was supposed to be scoped). if owner filter implicitly limits by workspace elsewhere, we might've accidentally dropped explicit workspace scoping.

jordyn: @devon can you point to the PR? I want to check the SQL.

devon: PR #4721 — changed buildFilters() in services/run-search. gist: https://git.internal/PR4721-diff

maria: tagged eng-security FYI — potential data leak. Can we throttle rollout?

monitor-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: potential multi-tenant exposure detected. Elevated to P1 if confirmed.

olivia: steps: 1) reproduce + collect raw DB query for `/api/v1/runs` with problematic params; 2) short patch to re-add explicit `workspace_id` filter before any owner-based optimization; 3) deploy hotfix to canary and verify cross-workspace rows disappear; 4) postmortem.

devon: on it. adding a feature-flagged quick revert now. patch: `WHERE workspace_id = $1` re-introduced at top of filter build. pushing to canary branch.

sachin: I'll pull logs to find other endpoints that use the same middleware (dashboards, saved searches). running grep.

maria: also please check frontend — we had a mapping layer that rewrites `owner:me` to `owner_id=<user>` client-side; make sure it's not rewriting workspace param accidentally.

devon: canary deployed to eu-west-1. initial check: canary run-list no longer returns workspace-b rows for maria's filters.

jordyn: thanks. schedule a short meeting in 15 to decide rollout to prod and whether to revoke any tokens or notify customers.

maria: Agreed. I'll prepare a short customer-facing note in case we need to reach out. tagging @product later. :exclamation:

olivia: follow-up: sachin found similar usage in `/api/v1/saved-searches` — I'll open a followup bug to audit all endpoints using the shared middleware.

devon: retro action: add unit tests for `buildFilters()` covering owner+workspace combinations, and add integration test that asserts no cross-workspace rows returned.

maria: thanks team. created incident channel #inc-1934567890-ghostrows and added everyone. will update after postmortem draft. :thumbsup:
